chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning Receives a Pure Yang Treasure in Desolate Era's War Arc
chapter_meta_description: The Xia Emperor mobilizes his million-strong army, equips his generals with Pure Yang treasures, and springs a space-sealing trap on the Seamless Gate.
og_title: The Emperor's Gambit: A Million Immortals Mobilize
og_description: The Xia Emperor moves his army, gifts the generals Pure Yang supreme-grade treasures, and springs a world-sealing formation on the Seamless Gate.
twitter_title: Massive Xianxia War Setup! The Emperor Strikes First!
twitter_description: The Xia Emperor abandons his capital and launches a bold offensive, setting a space-locking trap for the Seamless Gate.

lore_anchors.definition: A mobile fortress and innate spirit treasure used by the Xia Emperor to transport his million-strong army.
The highest tier of manufactured magic treasure, surpassing even Immortal-grade; often worth more than an Empyrean God's entire collection.
A pair of Pure Yang supreme-grade gloves that can transform into any weapon; designed specifically for the Xingtian Spirit's hands.
The divine entity formed through the Xingtian Formation, possessing god-tier durability and strength, used for close-quarters destruction.
A massive war formation requiring 100,000 Loose Immortals as a foundation and 1,000 Celestial Immortals as its framework.
The floating black fortress-city of the Seamless Gate, anchored above Baiji City.
The Grand Xia administrative region under attack, currently hosting both the imperial army and the Seamless Gate stronghold.
